name: Lisa
source:
Lisa is living in a low-rent part of Lunar City. She seems to be living an easy-going life while working a part-time job.

There's something mysterious about her and her unusual interest in Hal.

[Edited from [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sekaiproject/world-end-economica-complete] Kickstarter[/url]]

She gave the nickname "Hal" to Yoshiharu in order to cover his identity from his parents.
